text:
Served:
- 3 fried eggs: about 270 kcal (P 19, F 21).
- 2 slices toast: about 180 kcal (C 32, P 6, F 2).
- Grilled tomato: about 25 kcal.
- 3 mushrooms: about 10 kcal.
- Banana: about 110 kcal (C 27).
- Strawberries: about 20 kcal.
- Greek yogurt (Farmers Union, ~170 g): about 230 kcal (P 9, F 17, C 10).
- Butter/oil on the plates: maybe about 50 kcal more.

Total served comes to roughly 895 kcal; call it 900.

Leftover:
- About half the banana: about 55 kcal.
- Some yogurt residue in the bowl (yogurt was apparently mixed with strawberries) and cup: about 40 kcal.
- Plate scraps: about 15 kcal.

Total leftover is about 110 kcal, so about 790 kcal was eaten.

Macros eaten:
- Protein: eggs 19 + toast 6 + yogurt 7.5 + banana/veg 2 = about 34 g.
- Carbs: toast 32 + banana 13.5 + strawberries 4 + tomato/mushroom 5 + yogurt 8 = about 63 g.
- Fat: eggs 21 + toast 2 + yogurt 14 + butter/oil 5 = about 42 g.

Check: 34×4 + 63×4 + 42×9 = 136 + 252 + 378 = 766 kcal, which is close to the 790 estimate.
